splash.subtitle: Golf Ball Tracking
splash.description: Track and visualize golf ball trajectory with advanced computer vision technology

main.ballTrackingDesc: Upload your golf swing video to track and visualize the ball trajectory
main.swingRecordingDesc: Record and analyze your golf swing in real-time (Coming Soon)

ballTracking.uploadDescription: Select a video of your golf swing to analyze the ball trajectory. Make sure the golf ball is clearly visible throughout the swing.
ballTracking.instruction1: Record your golf swing with the ball clearly visible
ballTracking.instruction2: Ensure good lighting and stable camera position
ballTracking.instruction3: Keep the golf ball in frame throughout the swing
ballTracking.processingError: Failed to process video. Please try again.

result.analysisCompleteMessage: Golf ball trajectory has been successfully analyzed and visualized in your video.
result.trajectoryAdded: Ball trajectory has been added to your video
result.tip1: Use good lighting and avoid shadows on the golf ball
result.tip2: Keep the camera steady and the ball in frame
result.tip3: Record from a side angle for best trajectory visibility
result.savedMessage: Video has been saved to your gallery
result.saveError: Failed to save video to gallery
